pairs: In illo die exiens Jesus de domo,
In that day, Jesus, departing from the house,
Et congregatæ sunt ad eum turbæ multæ,
And such great crowds were gathered to him that he climbed into a boat
et omnis turba stabat in littore,
And the entire multitude stood on the shore.
et locutus est eis multa in parabolis,
And he spoke many things to them in parables,
a sower went out to sow seed.
and the birds of the air came
Then others fell in a rocky place,
where they did not have much soil.
because they had no depth of soil.
But when the sun rose up, they were scorched,
and because they had no roots,
Alia autem ceciderunt in terram bonam:
Yet some others fell upon good soil,
And his disciples drew near to him and said,
“Why do you speak to them in parables?”
Quia vobis datum est nosse mysteria regni cælorum:
“Because it has been given to you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven,
but it has not been given to them.
it shall be given to him,
and he shall have in abundance.
et quod habet auferetur ab eo.
even what he has shall be taken away from him.
For this reason, I speak to them in parables:
because seeing, they do not see,
and hearing they do not hear,
Et adimpletur in eis prophetia Isaiæ,
And so, in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah,
Incrassatum est enim cor populi hujus,
For the heart of this people has grown fat,
and with their ears they hear heavily,
and they have closed their eyes,
lest at any time they might see with their eyes,
and then I would heal them.’
Vestri autem beati oculi quia vident,
But blessed are your eyes, because they see,
and your ears, because they hear.
et justi cupierunt videre quæ videtis,
that many of the prophets and the just desired to see what you see,
and yet they did not see it,
and to hear what you hear,
and yet they did not hear it.
Listen, then, to the parable of the sower.
With anyone who hears the word of the kingdom
et rapit quod seminatum est in corde ejus:
and carries away what was sown in his heart.
hic est qui secus viam seminatus est.
This is he who received the seed by the side of the road.
Qui autem super petrosa seminatus est,
Then whoever has received the seed upon a rocky place,
this is one who hears the word
et continuo cum gaudio accipit illud:
and promptly accepts it with joy.
non habet autem in se radicem,
But he has no root in himself,
so it is only for a time;
when tribulation and persecution occur because of the word,
Qui autem seminatus est in spinis,
And whoever has received the seed among thorns,
this is he who hears the word,
but the cares of this age
and the falseness of riches suffocate the word,
and he is effectively without fruit.
Qui vero in terram bonam seminatus est,
Yet truly, whoever has received the seed into good soil,
this is he who hears the word,
and he produces: some a hundred fold,
He proposed another parable to them,
Simile factum est regnum cælorum homini, qui seminavit bonum semen in agro suo:
“The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
But while the men were sleeping,
et superseminavit zizania in medio tritici,
and sowed weeds amid the wheat,
And when the plants had grown,
So the servants of the Father of the family,
nonne bonum semen seminasti in agro tuo?
‘Lord, did you not sow good seed in your field?
Then how is it that it has weeds?’
‘A man who is an enemy has done this.’
So the servants said to him,
‘Is it your will that we should go and gather them up?’
lest perhaps in gathering the weeds,
eradicetis simul cum eis et triticum.
you might also root out the wheat together with it.
Sinite utraque crescere usque ad messem,
Permit both to grow until the harvest,
et in tempore messis dicam messoribus:
and at the time of the harvest,
I will say to the reapers:
et alligate ea in fasciculos ad comburendum:
Gather first the weeds, and bind them into bundles to burn,
triticum autem congregate in horreum meum.
but the wheat gather into my storehouse.’”
He proposed another parable to them, saying:
Simile est regnum cælorum grano sinapis, quod accipiens homo seminavit in agro suo:
“The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took and sowed in his field.
quod minimum quidem est omnibus seminibus:
It is, indeed, the least of all seeds,
it is greater than all the plants,
ita ut volucres cæli veniant, et habitent in ramis ejus.
so much so that the birds of the air come and dwell in its branches.”
He spoke another parable to them:
“The kingdom of heaven is like leaven,
quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farinæ satis tribus,
which a woman took and hid in three measures of fine wheat flour,
Hæc omnia locutus est Jesus in parabolis ad turbas:
All these things Jesus spoke in parables to the crowds.
et sine parabolis non loquebatur eis:
And he did not speak to them apart from parables,
ut impleretur quod dictum erat per prophetam dicentem:
in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet, saying:
“I will open my mouth in parables.
I will proclaim what has been hidden since the foundation of the world.”
et accesserunt ad eum discipuli ejus,
And his disciples drew near to him,
“Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
“He who sows the good seed is the Son of man.
Now the field is the world.
Bonum vero semen, hi sunt filii regni.
And the good seeds are the sons of the kingdom.
But the weeds are the sons of wickedness.
So the enemy who sowed them is the devil.
the harvest is the consummation of the age;
while the reapers are the Angels.
just as weeds are gathered up and burned with fire,
so shall it be at the consummation of the age.
The Son of man shall send out his Angels,
et colligent de regno ejus omnia scandala,
and they shall gather from his kingdom all who lead astray
et mittent eos in caminum ignis.
And he shall cast them into the furnace of fire,
Ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium.
where there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
Tunc justi fulgebunt sicut sol in regno Patris eorum.
Then the just ones shall shine like the sun, in the kingdom of their Father.
Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.
Simile est regnum cælorum thesauro abscondito in agro:
The kingdom of heaven is like a treasure hidden in a field.
he goes and sells everything that he has,
Iterum simile est regnum cælorum homini negotiatori,
the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant seeking good pearls.
Having found one pearl of great value,
and sold all that he had,
Iterum simile est regnum cælorum sagenæ missæ in mare,
Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net cast into the sea,
et ex omni genere piscium congreganti.
which gathers together all kinds of fish.
drawing it out and sitting beside the shore,
they selected the good into vessels,
but the bad they threw away.
So shall it be at the consummation of the age.
et separabunt malos de medio justorum,
and separate the bad from the midst of the just.
et mittent eos in caminum ignis:
And they shall cast them into the furnace of fire,
Have you understood all these things?”
Ideo omnis scriba doctus in regno cælorum,
“Therefore, every scribe well-taught about the kingdom of heaven,
is like a man, the father of a family,
qui profert de thesauro suo nova et vetera.
who offers from his storehouse both the new and the old.”
when Jesus had completed these parables,
And arriving in his own country,
he taught them in their synagogues,
so much so that they wondered
and power be with this one?
Is this not the son of a workman?
Is not his mother called Mary,
are they not all with us? Therefore,
from where has this one obtained all these things?”
And they took offense at him.
Et non fecit ibi virtutes multas propter incredulitatem illorum.
And he did not work many miracles there, because of their unbelief.
